**Finding submitted — deviation (Section 14.2).**

The IP package is largely aligned with our playbook: §14.1 keeps Customer Data and our independently developed IP with us (Vendor gets only a limited processing right), §15.1 blocks sale, advertising use, data commingling and model training, §14.3 leaves Vendor Technology with Copperleaf but applies the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to anything embedded in or needed to use a Deliverable, and §14.4 bars joint ownership and preserves our feedback rights.

The one problem is §14.2's internally inconsistent vesting: ownership arises "upon creation" but is also "subject to payment of the applicable Fees," meaning any fee dispute could defeat our title to commissioned work product. The validated redline strikes the payment condition so title vests on creation, leaving Vendor's payment remedies (including §13.3 suspension) intact, with a fallback of vesting on payment of undisputed Fees for the specific Deliverable.
